svg.text: Unity Catalog for Watchdog: one view of every workspace's jobs
System tables collect job and run history from every workspace in the same account and region. One service principal reads them and calls each workspace's Jobs API for live detail.
CAN MANAGE RUN only if it should
ONE REGION · ONE UNITY CATALOG METASTORE
a job in one Unity Catalog
on demand, or on a schedule
in every Unity Catalog metastore · read-only · Databricks-managed
Covers every workspace in this account and region, including non-UC workspaces.
Records arrive within about an hour · 365 days of history
live status and error text, one
Each region has its own metastore
Run one Watchdog per region, so
each region's data stays in that
System tables also include jobs from
workspaces not yet on Unity Catalog,
as long as you query from a UC
So the Watchdog needs one UC-enabled
The Jobs API works for any workspace
the service principal is assigned to,
with CAN VIEW on its jobs.
Jobs API calls, one per workspace
Sources, checked 2026-10-28: Databricks docs for system tables, Jobs system tables (system.lakeflow) and job permissions. Workspace and job names are examples.
